subject: [AMBER] Umbrella Sampling for  proteins/ligand into a membrane

messages.author: Matias Alejandro Marambio Soto
messages.body:
Hello to all,
I am trying to follow the Umbrella Sampling tutorial, but there is nothing detailed for ligand complexes in membrane proteins, is there anything related to this?
I'm looking for information, but I haven't really found much.
-Matias

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
You might get more response if you tell people which process you want to
model. For umbrella sampling rest matters more than the solvent or things
not related to the progress variable.
